articles.title: State Bank of India taps dollar bond market with five-year issue: Report
articles.content: The State Bank of India is set to tap into the dollar debt market, aiming to raise a minimum of $500 million by issuing five-year bonds. Marketing for this public offering is underway, with expectations to finalize the sale within the week. This move follows a previous postponement of a larger issue due to escalating borrowing costs.

articles.title: Lalithaa Jewellery Mart IPO price band fixed at Rs 190-201 for Rs 1,700 crore IPO; issue opens on August 17
articles.content: Lalithaa Jewellery Mart has set the price band for its Rs 1,700-crore IPO at Rs 190-201 per share. The issue comprises a Rs 1,200-crore fresh issue and a Rs 500-crore OFS by promoter Kiran Kumar Jain. With 61 stores across southern India and a strong presence in Tier II and III cities, the IPO opens on August 17.

articles.title: Adani Group stocks in focus after US judge drops criminal case against Gautam Adani
articles.content: Adani Group stocks are in focus after a US judge dismissed criminal charges against Gautam Adani, while clarifying the decision did not endorse the Justice Department’s move or assess the charges’ merits. The ruling followed scrutiny of Adani’s $10 billion US investment pledge. Adani Group has consistently denied wrongdoing in the case.
